clauses.quote: If the affected employee requests such a conference, it will be held consistent with applicable Alabama law and pursuant to the guidelines and within the scope of due process as set out in the United States Supreme Court case of Cleveland Board of Education v. Loudermill, 470 US. 532, 105 S. Ct. 1487, 1495 (1985) and other related court decisions.
clauses.notes: Grammatical subject 'it' refers to the conference; duty implicitly falls on management to conduct it per legal standards upon employee request.

clauses.quote: Accordingly, such conferences between the School Board and the employee will not be a full adversarial hearing involving the subpoenaing or cross-examination of witnesses or full blown pre-termination discovery.
clauses.subject_text: such conferences between the School Board and the employee
clauses.notes: Procedural boundary defining the non-adversarial nature of the conference to limit management's procedural burden.

clauses.quote: the employee will be given the rationale for the recommended disciplinary action
clauses.notes: Passive construction grants a substantive procedural right to the employee to receive the disciplinary rationale.

clauses.quote: and will be afforded an opportunity to speak to the School Board on matters relevant to such recommended disciplinary action.
clauses.notes: Coordinated independent clause granting the employee an opportunity to present statements during the disciplinary conference.

clauses.quote: The employee shall have the right to counsel and to have a court reporter record his/her statement, both at the expense of the employee.
clauses.notes: Explicit contractual right to representation and recording, with costs explicitly borne by the employee.

clauses.quote: The School Board will vote to determine whether such recommended disciplinary action shall be effectuated.
clauses.notes: Mandates formal management action to conclude the disciplinary process following the conference.
